map.→ 打开填料（碳酸钙/滑石粉）添加工具: -> Open the filler (calcium carbonate / talc) addition tool
map.二者功能不同：碳酸钙提升不透明度、降低成本，滑石粉改善平滑度与印刷适性。配比需兼: The two serve different purposes: calcium carbonate raises opacity and lowers cost, while talc improves smoothness and printability. The mix must satisfy both and they are not interchangeable; a high filler loading sacrifices strength and needs a reinforcing agent.
map.加填量是不是越高越好？: Is a higher filler loading always better?
map.否。加填提高不透明度与平滑度，但会降低纸页强度、挺度与施胶度，并增加掉粉风险。应: No. Filling raises opacity and smoothness, but lowers sheet strength, stiffness and sizing, and increases dusting risk. Take the lower limit once opacity meets the target, to preserve strength.
map.填料（碳酸钙/滑石粉）添加 使用指南: How to use the filler (calcium carbonate / talc) addition tool
map.填料（碳酸钙/滑石粉）添加工具按输入参数估算造纸填料添加比例与成纸灰分，适合造纸: The filler (calcium carbonate / talc) addition tool estimates the filler addition ratio and resulting ash content of the paper from input parameters, suited to paper-process formulation and cost/strength trade-off analysis.
map.成本优化时，在指标达标前提下调整高价与低价填料比例。: For cost optimisation, adjust the ratio of premium to low-cost filler while keeping the targets met.
map.排放量 = A × B (kg)，1 t = 1000 kg: Emission = A x B (kg), 1 t = 1000 kg
map.文化用纸（双胶、铜版）加填碳酸钙/滑石粉改善不透明度与平滑度，需控制两种填料配比: Adding calcium carbonate or talc to cultural papers (offset, coated) improves opacity and smoothness, so the ratio between the two fillers must be controlled.
map.碳酸钙和滑石粉能互相替代吗？: Can calcium carbonate and talc substitute for each other?
map.算例：两种填料配比（碳酸钙 100 份、滑石粉 50 份）: Example: two filler ratios (calcium carbonate 100 parts, talc 50 parts)
map.质量管控中，记录每批填料实际添加量，追溯波动对纸页性能的影响。: In quality control, record the actual filler addition of each batch and trace how variations affect sheet properties.
map.：总添加=100+50=150 份；配比(碳酸钙:滑石粉)=100:50=2.0: : total addition = 100+50 = 150 parts; ratio (calcium carbonate : talc) = 100:50 = 2.00:1; difference = 50 parts; average = 75 parts. Formula: ratio = a/b, total addition = a+b.
map.：碳酸钙占比=100÷150≈66.7%，滑石粉占比=50÷150≈33.3%；: : calcium carbonate share = 100/150 ≈ 66.7%, talc share = 50/150 ≈ 33.3%; if the total addition is fixed, convert each filler quantity at these proportions. Formula: share = a/(a+b)*100%.
